biotools.summary: Desktop viewer for scientific and medical images on Windows and macOS, centred on microscopy and whole slide pathology. Opens whole slide scanner formats (Aperio SVS, Hamamatsu NDPI, MIRAX MRXS, Leica SCN, Ventana BIF) alongside acquisition formats (Zeiss CZI, Nikon ND2, Leica LIF, TIFF/OME-TIFF) and DICOM, including CT, MRI and X-ray series, in a single application. Provides pyramid navigation of gigapixel images, metadata inspection, calibrated measurements, annotations, and on-device segmentation and object counting for microscopy images. Medical scans are for viewing and measurement only; not for diagnosis.
